case_summary.review_route_explanation: No specific review or appeal route exists for admission or refusal of a disclosed AI attendance proxy, as proxy attendance is unaddressed.
case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Verification and admission of the disclosed proxy, and a valid basis for fulfilling any compulsory student participation.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: Under Protocol v1.1 (adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15), no relevant provision was identified in the documents and searches checked (including zero-hit searches 'attendance proxy', 'authorised proxy', 'false attendance', 'attendance appeal', and 'proxy identity') to verify or admit a disclosed AI avatar proxy in online lectures or determine whether it can fulfil compulsory participation.
case_summary.case_note: UWA Assessment Policy N049 and EVA Policy N045 distinguish non-compulsory lecture attendance from active student participation, while N071 bars credential sharing, but no relevant provision was identified in the documents and searches checked addressing disclosed AI avatar attendance proxies. Consequently, verification, admission, and participation-validity rules for a disclosed AI proxy remain unaddressed in the reviewed sources, creating a critical gap. Note that Protocol v1.1 critical-risk criteria were adopted after preliminary review.
